_what: RAW SUBPROCESS KILLS ON A CLOCK that this tree carries. A RATCHET BY MEMBERSHIP: it may only ever SHRINK. Nothing here is blessed and nothing here is exempt -- every entry is printed on every run with its remedy, and any site NOT in this file is refused with rc 1. IT IS NOW EMPTY: the four sites it was opened with were CONVERTED, not re-recorded, so the only verdict this file can produce is a refusal.
_why_not_just_fixed: SUPERSEDED by the owner ruling of 2026-09-07 (R4): the four recorded sites were closed rather than carried. Each was a live production launch, so each conversion carries its own both-directions proof -- a motionless child is stopped WITH ITS PROCESS GROUP and reported by name, and a child that is still moving is never stopped, which the wall clock it replaced could not promise. The gate's RESIDUAL_CONTAINER_CLOCK class still reports rather than refuses; that is a different class, owned elsewhere, and is untouched.
_the_remedy_for_every_entry: Route the launch through `_progress_run.run` -- it is a drop-in for `subprocess.run(..., timeout=N)`, converted by DELETING the `timeout=` argument -- and report `_progress_run.Stalled` by name. The supervisor stops a child only when captured output, the process tree's CPU and its block I/O were ALL flat for a count of consecutive looks.
_measured: 2026-09-07, sweep of programs/*.py + tools/**/*.py, 4 sites recorded at v1.18.36 and 0 remaining at v1.18.40+R4. The remedy for each was the same three edits: route the launch through `_progress_run.run`, pass `start_new_session=True` where the site had a hand-written group reap, and report `_progress_run.Stalled` by name. Zero in programs/tests/ (that population is excluded and the exclusion is measured -- see the scanner's docstring).
_key_is: <repo-relative file>::<enclosing function>::<the call as written>. Never a line number: a recorded site keyed on a line moves on every unrelated edit above it.
_keys_are_the_tools_own: Every key here was READ OFF a run of the gate, never typed from the source: the first version of this file guessed four enclosing function names and the gate reported all four as TIGHTEN (recorded but not present) while separately refusing the four real ones. Regenerate a key by running the gate and copying the one it prints.
